warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 2.50 + 2.50 + 1.40 + 1.60 (8.00). Origin A1. Vector CAD PDF with no usable text layer — every value read off the rendered page. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02, S-03, A-07 and A-08.

Two roofs: S-02 is the high mono-pitch roof (drawn -1.00 to 4.00 on x — it overhangs grid 2 by 1.00, chain 1.00 + 2.00) and S-03 the low roof over bay 2-3 (drawn 2 to 7.00). Both print 1.00 + 2.00 in bay 2-3, so 2' (4.00) is one line on both. S-04 is the porch roof over D-E x 2-3 (chain 1.50 + 1.50, 1.00 beyond grid 3 and beyond E).

Every printed tick became a line (section 4 rule 4): truss panel chains T1 / T2 / T5 (x, 1.000 each) and T3 / T4 (y). The truss elevations print no grid bubbles; their chains were matched to the grid by their printed sub-totals (T1 3.00 + 3.00 = 6.00 grid 1-3; T3 3.00 + 2.50 + 2.50 = 8.00 E-A with T2 / T5 / T2 / T1 / T1 drawn at E, D, C, B, A; T4 3.90 + 2.50 = 6.40 D-B-A, posts on the columns D3, B3, A3). T4 inner ticks are positioned off the upper line (A + 0.833 / + 1.666, B + 0.975 x 3); 0.833 x 3 = 2.499 against the printed 2.50 — a 0.001 rounding in the drawing, absorbed by the last segment.

B'' (3.75, S-02 high-roof chain 1.25 + 1.25) and B''' (3.80, S-03 low-roof chain 1.30 + 1.20, T3 chain agrees) are 0.05 apart — kept both: they are different rafter lines on two different roofs. A' (-1.60, GS slab edge) and A'' (-1.00, roof edge) are different edges too, as are E' (9.00, roof edge) and E'' (9.10, GS slab edge).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนน (A-07 / A-08; A-01 notes agree). Three levels share the printed label ระดับหลังคา, so each id keeps its printed value (+3.46 / +4.01 / +4.96) to stay unique. ระดับฝ้าเพดาน and ระดับดินเดิม print no value (level_m null).

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06 plus A-07 / A-08 (building sections, for levels and the edge ticks). The other architectural / MEP sheets (A-03..A-06, A-09, A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05 / S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (section sizes, cap size and depths, slab thicknesses, stair steps), which stay on their elements; truss heights stay on the truss elements.
